title: AnantaTPA
description: Teleportation plugin specially made for Folia but also compatible with Bukkit/Spigot/Paper/Folia or any Paper-based fork.
body:
## AnantaTPA
**A feature-rich TPA plugin specially built for Folia 1.21.1+**

AnantaTPA brings a polished teleport request system to your Folia server with full GUI integration, persistent player data, and deep customization — all designed to work safely across Folia's threaded region model.

---

### Features

**Teleport System**
- `/tpa` and `/tpahere` with warmup countdown and movement cancellation
- Request expiry, per-player cooldowns, and inbox limits
- Cross-world teleport support

**GUI Integration**
- Player selector GUI — browse online players, see their world, distance, ping, and flying status
- Request popup — incoming TPA requests open a DonutTPA-style 27-slot GUI showing the sender's head, world, and flight status
- Inbox GUI — manage all pending requests with Accept All / Deny All
- Settings GUI — toggle TPA, TPAHere, auto-accept, GUI popups, and coordinate visibility
- History GUI — view past teleports with one-click re-request
- Admin panel — monitor all online players, active requests, and warmup status

**Player Controls**
- `/tpatoggle` / `/tpaheretoggle` — block all incoming requests
- `/tpaauto` — auto-accept every incoming TPA
- `/tpaguitoggle` — switch between GUI popup and chat-only notifications
- `/tpacancel` — cancel your own outgoing request
- Block individual players directly from the inbox GUI

**Customization**
- Fully configurable messages with `&` color codes and `&#RRGGBB` hex color support
- Configurable sounds for every action (countdown, teleport, accept, deny, error)
- World nicknames (Overworld, Nether, The End) shown throughout GUIs
- Chat + action bar messages for key events
- All timings configurable — warmup, timeout, cooldown

**Data & Persistence**
- SQLite database — settings, block lists, and teleport history survive restarts
- Per-player preferences saved automatically on quit and server stop

---

### Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/tpa [player]` | Send a TPA request or open player selector |
| `/tpahere [player]` | Request a player to come to you |
| `/tpaccept [player]` | Accept a request |
| `/tpadeny [player]` | Deny a request |
| `/tpacancel` | Cancel your outgoing request |
| `/tpainbox` | Open your request inbox |
| `/tpasettings` | Open settings GUI |
| `/tpahistory` | View teleport history |
| `/tpatoggle` | Toggle TPA on/off |
| `/tpaheretoggle` | Toggle TPAHere on/off |
| `/tpaauto` | Toggle auto-accept |
| `/tpaguitoggle` | Toggle GUI popup |
| `/tpareload` | Reload config (op) |
| `/tpaadmin` | Admin panel (op) |

---

**Compatibility**
- Folia 1.21.1+
- Paper 1.21.1+
- Purpur 1.21.1+
- Any Paper-based fork
